Hi Team,

Caramel Betquet Update:

Yesterday, we ran using the same centerline settings as our previous production, and everything went well during first shift.

Today, we started with those same centerline settings, but we experienced an issue with the caramel slab height. It was measuring between 18.5 and 19 mm, so we made the appropriate adjustment by decreasing the thickness regulator on the Combar by 0.2. However, there was no noticeable change. We reduced it by another 0.2, but again there was very little difference. We continued making adjustments until we had reduced it by a total of 0.8, which finally achieved the desired slab height.

The unusual part is that this behavior is not consistent with our previous experience, where much smaller adjustments produced the expected results.
